items.title: 「AI股神」又出手了？SanDisk暴漲11%、記憶體和晶片股「短期選擇權」爆巨量
paras: 美國人工智慧（AI）與半導體類股近期出現大額短期期權交易，市場焦點再度轉向曾因高槓桿押注AI股票而聲名大噪的「AI股神」、避險基金Situational Awareness經理人Leopold Aschenbrenner。
週五（18日），約有9,600萬美元的看漲期權權利金集中流入SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 、美光科技(MU-US) 、英特爾(INTC-US) 及邁威爾科技(MRVL-US) 等4檔AI概念股。其中，SanDisk股價盤中一度大漲11%。
《CNBC》主持人Jim Cramer在社群平台X發文表示，這波交易讓他聯想到Aschenbrenner重新進場。
Aschenbrenner是OpenAI前核心研究員，也是AI主題避險基金Situational Awareness創辦人，過去曾因運用高槓桿大舉買進半導體與AI企業的短期看漲期權而受到市場關注。

近億美元看漲期權集中押注4檔AI股

根據ZeroHedge彙整的盤中交易數據，這批將於10月2日到期的看漲期權，交易內容如下：

美光：履約價1,000美元，約1萬張合約，權利金約4,400萬美元。
SanDisk：履約價1,600美元，約4,200張合約，權利金約4,100萬美元。
英特爾：履約價115美元，約2萬張合約，權利金約730萬美元。
邁威爾科技：履約價250美元，約3,500張合約，權利金約385萬美元。


交易發生時，SanDisk股價已高於期權履約價；美光股價則接近履約價，英特爾與邁威爾科技的履約價則略高於當時股價。
由於上述期權距離到期日僅剩約兩週，時間價值衰減及Gamma敏感度均相當高，標的股價若未能迅速朝有利方向移動，期權價值可能大幅縮水。
Cramer指出，這批期權的到期日落在美光公布第4季財報之後，而該財報受到整個記憶體產業關注。他早在8月便對記憶體類股抱持樂觀看法，認為AI資料中心需求及供應紀律，正改變記憶體產業過去景氣循環的運作模式。

交易標的與手法引發市場聯想

目前美國證券交易委員會（SEC）的申報文件尚未揭露這批期權的買家身分，但市場之所以猜測Aschenbrenner重新進場，主要是因為交易標的與其過去的投資布局高度重疊。
Situational Awareness在6月底提交的監管文件顯示，SanDisk與美光當時分別約占基金持倉57億美元及56億美元，是該基金最大的兩項投資。此次近億美元的期權交易，也集中在這兩檔股票上。
此外，這批交易採用大額、短天期看漲期權的方式，也與Aschenbrenner過去的操作風格相近。其基金過去曾以高槓桿押注AI市場動能，槓桿率一度達400%。透過大量買進短期看漲期權，可能促使做市商進行Gamma避險交易，進而推升相關股票價格。
交易時間點也與近期市場觀察相互呼應。《金融時報》9月11日報導，Aschenbrenner已透過彈性期權（Flex Options），重新建立超微半導體(AMD-US) 、英特爾、SK海力士(SKHY-US) 、SanDisk及CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 等標的的部位。
野村證券策略師Charlie McElligott當時觀察到，AI及半導體相關標的在數日內累計出現約3.15億美元的期權權利金交易，涉及約11億美元的Delta曝險。
他也指出，半導體ETF未來3個月的看漲期權偏斜度已升至歷史高位。

改用全額支付期權　但押注AI動能的策略未變

Aschenbrenner的基金今年7月遭遇重大損失。在AI類股回檔期間，Situational Awareness基金淨值暴跌67%，並將大部分持倉出售給Citadel。
《金融時報》當時將這起事件列為避險基金史上最大單筆虧損之一，但該基金當年仍錄得約80%的正報酬。
Aschenbrenner在7月底致投資人的信中表示，未來將「另謀再戰之日」，並承諾日後的公開市場投資將採取「全額支付」方式管理。
與先前透過總收益互換（TRS）取得槓桿的做法不同，市場認為Aschenbrenner這次改用全額支付期權。這類交易的最大損失通常限於已支付的權利金，理論上不會面臨追繳保證金或因槓桿而遭到強制平倉的風險。
這項調整可能與基金在崩盤後面臨的融資限制有關。摩根大通已終止與該基金的借貸關係，美國證券交易委員會也向曾為基金提供融資的銀行索取相關資訊，先前合作的經紀商則遭到美國司法部調查。
據《金融時報》報導，Aschenbrenner後續轉向專注科技產業的經紀商Clear Street，重新建立合作關係。
不過， McElligott指出，近期交易仍呈現股價與波動率同步上升的特徵，與7月市場崩跌前的情況相似。這代表交易仍可能集中押注流動性相對有限、具市場動能的股票，試圖透過期權交易帶動股價進一步上漲。
若市場動能反轉，短天期期權的權利金可能迅速歸零，但投資人無法再透過調整槓桿來緩衝損失。
Situational Awareness第3季的13F持股報告預計於11月中旬提交，屆時市場才能透過監管文件確認這批期權交易的實際買家身分。

items.title: 智寶首度進軍好萊塢 《電鋸甜心》啟動真人版電影計畫
items.title_en: ZhiBao Enters Hollywood for the First Time, Launches Live‑Action Film Project for "Lollipop Chainsaw"
paras: 動漫遊戲(ACG)IP公司智寶(7824-TW)擴大全球 IP 計畫，繼正式公開《電鋸甜心2》遊戲開發計畫後，接力宣布將推進《LollipopChainsaw 電鋸甜心》真人版電影及動畫拍攝計畫，也是公司IP首度進軍好萊塢。
智寶總經理鄧橋表示，《電鋸甜心》具備成為經典娛樂品牌的所有要素，因此透過與跨國夥伴們合作，製作出世界級的遊戲、動畫與真人影視作品。其中，《電鋸甜心》真人版電影將為延續原作世界觀的全新原創故事，時間軸設定於原作遊戲事件之前，目前選角大致底定，明年開始拍攝及動畫後製，智寶最快明年可開始認列授權金，後續上映後則可認列票房分潤。

鄧橋進一步指出，《電鋸甜心》全球 IP 計畫已正式進入跨國團隊協作與跨載體同步推進的階段，主要參與方包括IP 原作版權DRAGAMI GAMES、IP 計畫統籌智寶、遊戲製作JP UNIVERSE、影視開發Ambitious Entertainment/Non Stop Studios/Orange Chariot/Throne、策略投資包括台灣大哥大(3045-TW)、威剛(3260-TW)、影一製作所等。
《電鋸甜心》首部真人版電影由智寶主動發起，集結好萊塢規格的歐美電影製作團隊，由5位製作人共同操刀，除了鄧橋外，還有Throne執行長結城崇史、Orange Chariot 共同創辦人Robert Franke、Ambitious Entertainment 執行長 Kirk Shaw，以及 Non Stop Studios Corp. 總裁Patricio Rabuffetti。

團隊陣容具備了豐沛的國際影視製作實績，Kirk Shaw 為好萊塢最具產量與實績的製作人之一，累計操刀 250 部以上電影與7部電視影集，曾任奧斯卡金像獎得獎作品《危機倒數》（The Hurt Locker）副製作人；Patricio Rabuffetti 所帶領的 Non Stop 擁有逾25年經驗、整合歐美20家以上公司的影音價值鏈網絡；Robert Franke 曾操刀與富士電視台、HuluJapan 共製合作影集。
paras_en: Animation‑game (ACG) IP company ZhiBao (7824‑TW) is expanding its global IP program. After officially announcing the development of the "Lollipop Chainsaw 2" game, the company now reveals plans to advance a live‑action film and animation production for "Lollipop Chainsaw," marking its first foray into Hollywood for the IP.

General manager Deng Qiao said that "Lollipop Chainsaw" has all the ingredients to become a classic entertainment brand, and through cooperation with multinational partners it will be turned into world‑class games, animation and live‑action audiovisual works. The live‑action film will tell an original story that continues the original universe but is set before the events of the game. Casting is largely settled, filming and animation post‑production will begin next year, and ZhiBao could start recognizing licensing fees as early as next year, with box‑office revenue sharing to be recorded after the film’s release.

Deng further noted that the global IP plan for "Lollipop Chainsaw" has entered a stage of cross‑border team collaboration and multi‑platform simultaneous development. Key participants include the IP original rights holder DRAGAMI GAMES, ZhiBao as the IP project coordinator, game developer JP UNIVERSE, film‑TV developers Ambitious Entertainment, Non Stop Studios and Orange Chariot, as well as strategic investors such as Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW), ADATA (3260‑TW) and Ying‑One Production.

The first live‑action movie for "Lollipop Chainsaw" is being initiated by ZhiBao, assembling a Hollywood‑standard European‑American production team. Five producers are steering the project: besides Deng Qiao, there are Throne CEO Takashi Yuki, Orange Chariot co‑founder Robert Franke, Ambitious Entertainment CEO Kirk Shaw, and Non Stop Studios Corp. President Patricio Rabuffetti.

The team brings extensive international film‑production credentials. Kirk Shaw is one of Hollywood’s most prolific producers, having overseen more than 250 films and seven TV series and serving as associate producer on the Oscar‑winning "The Hurt Locker." Patricio Rabuffetti’s Non Stop Studios boasts over 25 years of experience and a media‑value‑chain network that integrates more than 20 European and American companies. Robert Franke has produced co‑productions with Fuji TV and Hulu Japan.

items.title: 志聖慶一甲子家庭日逾800人同歡　加發4000萬元獎金感謝同仁
items.title_en: Zhi Sheng Celebrates 60th Anniversary Family Day with Over 800 Participants, Grants Additional NT$40 Million Bonus to Thank Employees
paras: 台積電(2467-TW)供應鏈志聖工業(2467-TW)今(19)日舉辦60周年家庭日盛事，林口、台中廠員工與眷屬逾800人齊聚桃園六福村，共同歡慶一甲子里程碑。董事長梁茂生、梁又文現場宣布，公司將加發總額4000萬元獎金，感謝全體同仁今年的努力，也感謝家人長期在背後支持。
志聖董事長梁茂生、總經理梁又文指出，志聖走過60年，最珍貴的力量始終來自「人」，每一項成果都有同仁的投入，也有家人在背後一路相伴。
PCB及半導體設備廠的志聖，力在今天晚間的「點亮60」星光音樂會中特別播放以《禮運大同篇》為歌詞重新演繹的志聖60週年《孔子之歌》，傳遞文化傳承與人本價值；孫淑媚、魏如昀、李聖傑也接力演出，與同仁及家屬共享60周年的喜悅。
志聖026年1-8月營收70.77億元，已經超越2025年全年，年增83.37%。志聖 2026 上半年營收 50.44 億元，較去年同期成長 78.92%；歸屬母公司業主稅後純益 11.06 億元，年增 2.09 倍，每股純益 7.16 元。
paras_en: TSMC (2467‑TW) supply‑chain partner Zhi Sheng Industrial (2467‑TW) held a grand 60th‑anniversary family day today (19th), bringing together more than 800 employees and their families from the Linkou and Taichung plants at Taoyuan’s Leofoo Village to celebrate the six‑decade milestone. Chairmen Liang Maosheng and Liang Youwen announced on site that the company will issue an additional total bonus of NT$40 million to thank all staff for their efforts this year and to appreciate families for their long‑standing support behind the scenes.

Chairman Liang Maosheng and General Manager Liang Youwen noted that after 60 years, Zhi Sheng’s most valuable strength has always come from “people”; every achievement reflects the dedication of employees and the continuous support of their families.

At tonight’s “Light Up 60” star‑filled concert, Zhi Sheng— a PCB and semiconductor equipment manufacturer— specially performed a re‑interpreted “Confucius Song” for its 60th anniversary, using lyrics from the “Li Yun Da Tong” piece to convey cultural heritage and human‑centric values. Performers Sun Shumei, Wei Ruyun and Li Shengjie also took the stage, sharing the joy of the 60th anniversary with colleagues and their families.

Zhi Sheng’s revenue for January‑August 2026 was NT$7.077 billion, already surpassing the full‑year 2025 figure, an 83.37% year‑over‑year increase. For the first half of 2026, revenue reached NT$5.044 billion, up 78.92% from the same period last year; net profit attributable to the parent company was NT$1.106 billion, a 2.09‑fold increase year‑over‑year, and earnings per share were NT$7.16.

items.title: 為川習會做準備！貝森特將會何立峰：美中聚焦AI、稀土與關稅休戰
items.title_en: Preparing for the Trump‑Xi Summit! Bessent to Meet He Lifeng: US‑China Focus on AI, Rare‑Earths and Tariff Truce
paras: 在川習會即將舉行之際，消息人士透露，美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）計劃於本週末在紐約市與中國國務院副總理何立峰會面，屆時將討論人工智慧（AI）、貿易、稀土及經濟議題。美國與中國是推動先進AI工具開發及該技術在全球普及的兩大主要力量，稀土則在科技產品製造過程中扮演關鍵角色。
根據《路透》報導，美國貿易代表葛里爾（Jamieson Greer）的辦公室在一份聲明中表示，貝森特、葛里爾及何立峰將於週日（20日）在紐約會面，為美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平9月24日在華盛頓舉行的峰會做準備。
葛里爾辦公室在聲明中表示，川普政府將持續推動與中國的平衡貿易關係，監督近期承諾的落實情況、優化非敏感商品貿易，並改善美國農民、製造商及勞工進入中國市場的機會。
葛里爾在聲明中表示：「川普政府將持續透過監督近期承諾的落實情況、優化非敏感商品貿易，以及改善美國農民、製造商與勞工進入市場的機會，推動與中國之間的平衡貿易。」
貝森特在另一份聲明中表示，預計此次美中經貿磋商將涵蓋「開放權重及封閉權重模型」。開放權重模型是指核心要素可供公眾取得的AI系統。使用者可以下載這些模型，並針對特定任務進行微調。
近來，因開放模型成本可能低於封閉權重模型，中國開放權重AI模型受到美國企業關注。中國AI模型甚至已被美國政府採用。根據《路透》先前報導，美國政府一個網站使用中國企業開發的AI模型，協助使用者搜尋聯邦法規草案。
不過，美國聯邦調查局（FBI）曾指控該模型開發商阿里巴巴(09988-HK) 惡意抄襲Anthropic的技術。
貝森特在談及美中會談的聲明中表示：「美國仍是AI領域的領導者。我們願意就如何避免共同風險，以及避免我們兩套體系走向分裂展開討論。」
貝森特過去曾呼籲美中就AI安全「防護欄」達成共識，以避免功能強大的AI模型落入非國家惡意行為者手中。
週二，貝森特在美國眾議院金融服務委員會聽證會上被問及AI安全問題。他表示，是否放慢開發速度應由美國AI企業自行決定，但他主張，為了確保安全，企業應對其開發及生成的內容承擔責任。

關稅休戰、稀土供應及芬太尼前驅物成焦點

有關紐約會談的細節目前仍相當有限。這場會議預計將探索川普與習近平可能達成共識的領域。
消息人士表示，週日（20日）的會談可能延續至週一（21日），並以「工作層級」的形式進行；同時，議程將保持彈性，以便雙方廣泛討論各項議題。
貝森特與何立峰預計討論的事項，還包括是否延長將於11月10日到期的關稅休戰協議，以及改善中國製稀土磁鐵與關鍵礦物的供應。
中國去年在美中關稅衝突升溫之際，大幅限制部分稀土相關產品及關鍵礦物的供應。根據先前的休戰安排，中方承諾恢復關鍵礦物對美國及全球市場的供應。
然而，一名美國高級官員週五（18日）向記者表示，中國在履行相關承諾方面「未達標準」，這也將成為川普與習近平峰會前的重要討論議題。
該名官員指出，川普政府也希望中國採取更強有力的措施，遏止芬太尼前驅化學品流入美國。
美中休戰協議也將川普第二任期內加徵的關稅稅率限制在約20%。美國最高法院後來推翻川普依據《國家緊急狀態法》加徵的關稅，其中包括與芬太尼走私相關的關稅。
不過，川普政府已依據新的法律授權重新建立相關關稅措施。美國已因強迫勞動指控，恢復對中國商品課徵12.5%的關稅；此外，美方正完成另一項關稅調查，旨在抑制其所稱中國普遍存在的產能過剩問題。
今年5月的川習會談中，中國承諾增加採購美國農產品，並至少購買200架波音(BA-US) 飛機，但相關交易的具體進展至今仍未明朗。
華盛頓亞洲協會政策主任Wendy Cutler表示，由於籌備時間有限，外界對貝森特與何立峰在此次川習峰會前促成重大新協議的期待不高。她指出，美中雙方都有意避免貿易緊張局勢再次升溫。
Cutler說，這次會談更像是管理雙邊關係，並確保關稅休戰協議中的各項內容確實獲得落實。
此外，美中兩國今年5月同意透過所謂「貿易委員會」機制，就降低非戰略性商品關稅展開討論，並設立類似論壇處理特定投資議題。
儘管川普政府已收緊美國企業對中國部分產業的投資限制，但根據《路透》週五報導，美方正研擬相關規則，可能允許美國製藥企業投資具發展潛力的中國藥物，並與中方進行授權交易。
中國商務部週六（19日）表示，何立峰也將率領中國企業代表團赴美，在川習峰會前參與經貿磋商。
這支企業代表團的安排，與川普今年5月帶領美國企業執行長代表團訪問北京的做法相呼應。與此同時，川普近期表達願意讓中國汽車製造商赴美設廠，而美國汽車產業團體週五則以國家安全為由，敦促川普維持對中國汽車在美銷售的有效禁令。
paras_en: As the Trump‑Xi summit approaches, sources say US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent plans to meet Chinese Vice‑Premier He Lifeng in New York City this weekend to discuss artificial intelligence (AI), trade, rare‑earths and economic issues. The United States and China are the two main forces driving advanced AI tool development and the global spread of the technology, while rare‑earths play a critical role in the manufacture of tech products.

According to Reuters, US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer’s office said Bessent, Greer and He Lifeng will meet in New York on Sunday the 20th to prepare for the summit between President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping scheduled for September 24 in Washington.

Greer’s office said the Trump administration will continue to pursue a balanced trade relationship with China, monitor the implementation of recent commitments, optimise trade in non‑sensitive goods, and improve opportunities for US farmers, manufacturers and workers to access the Chinese market.

In the statement Greer added: “The Trump administration will keep pushing for balanced trade with China by overseeing the fulfilment of recent pledges, optimising non‑sensitive goods trade, and improving market access for US farmers, manufacturers and labourers.”

Bessent said in a separate statement that the upcoming US‑China economic talks are expected to cover “open‑weight and closed‑weight models.” Open‑weight models refer to AI systems whose core components are publicly accessible; users can download them and fine‑tune them for specific tasks.

Recently, because open‑weight models may be cheaper than closed‑weight ones, Chinese open‑weight AI models have attracted US corporate interest. Chinese AI models have even been adopted by the US government. Reuters previously reported that a US government website uses an AI model developed by a Chinese firm to help users search draft federal regulations.
However, the FBI has accused the model’s developer, Alibaba (09988‑HK), of maliciously copying Anthropic’s technology.
In remarks about the US‑China talks, Bessent said: “The United States remains a leader in AI. We are willing to discuss how to avoid shared risks and prevent our two systems from diverging.”
Bessent has previously called for US‑China consensus on AI safety “guardrails” to keep powerful AI models from falling into the hands of non‑state malicious actors.

On Tuesday, Bessent was questioned about AI safety at a hearing of the House Financial Services Committee. He said whether to slow development should be decided by US AI firms, but he argued that companies should be responsible for the content they develop and generate to ensure safety.

Tariff truce, rare‑earth supply and fentanyl precursors become focal points. Details of the New York meeting remain limited, and the talks are expected to explore areas where Trump and Xi might reach agreement.
Sources say the Sunday (20th) meeting could extend into Monday (21st) and be conducted at a “working‑level” format; the agenda will stay flexible to allow broad discussion of issues.

Bessent and He are also expected to discuss whether to extend the tariff‑truce agreement that expires on November 10, and how to improve the supply of Chinese‑made rare‑earth magnets and critical minerals.

Last year, amid a heated US‑China tariff clash, China sharply restricted the supply of certain rare‑earth products and critical minerals. Under the previous truce, China pledged to restore supply of these minerals to the US and global markets.
Nevertheless, a senior US official told reporters on Friday (the 18th) that China has “fallen short” of meeting those commitments, a point that will be a key topic before the Trump‑Xi summit.
The official added that the Trump administration also wants China to take stronger steps to curb the flow of fentanyl precursor chemicals into the United States.

The US‑China truce also caps the tariff rates imposed during Trump’s second term at roughly 20%. The US Supreme Court later struck down the tariffs Trump added under the National Emergency Act, including those tied to fentanyl smuggling.

However, the Trump administration has re‑authorized related tariff measures under new law. The US has reinstated a 12.5% tariff on Chinese goods over forced‑labour allegations; additionally, another tariff investigation is being completed to address what the US calls China’s pervasive overcapacity.
At the May Trump‑Xi talks, China pledged to increase purchases of US agricultural products and to buy at least 200 Boeing (BA‑US) aircraft, but concrete progress on those deals remains unclear.

Wendy Cutler, policy director at the Washington Asia Society, said expectations are low that Bessent and He will broker any major new agreements before the summit, given the limited preparation time. She noted both sides want to avoid a fresh escalation of trade tensions.
Cutler said the meeting is more about managing the bilateral relationship and ensuring the provisions of the tariff‑truce are fully implemented.
Moreover, in May the two countries agreed to use a “trade committee” mechanism to discuss lowering tariffs on non‑strategic goods and to set up a forum to handle specific investment issues.

Although the Trump administration has tightened restrictions on US investment in certain Chinese sectors, Reuters reported on Friday that the US is drafting rules that could allow US pharma firms to invest in promising Chinese drug companies and to engage in licensing deals with Chinese partners.
China’s Ministry of Commerce said on Saturday (the 19th) that He Lifeng will also lead a delegation of Chinese business representatives to the US for economic talks ahead of the Trump‑Xi summit.

The business delegation mirrors Trump’s May‑year visit with a US corporate‑CEO delegation to Beijing, and at the same time Trump has recently expressed willingness to let Chinese automakers set up plants in the US, while US auto industry groups on Friday urged Trump to keep the effective ban on Chinese car sales in the United States for national‑security reasons.

items.title: OpenAI奧特曼下週赴聯合國安理會談AI安全！聚焦國際協調與失控風險
items.title_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman to Brief UN Security Council on AI Safety Next Week, Focusing on International Coordination and Runaway Risks
paras: OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）下週將在紐約舉行的聯合國大會期間，向聯合國安全理事會進行簡報，屆時全球各國領袖將齊聚紐約出席一年一度的聯合國大會。
根據《路透》報導，OpenAI發言人週五（18日）表示，奧特曼下週將親自向聯合國安理會的公開會議進行簡報。
聯合國安理會由15個成員國組成，預計於下週三（23日）召開AI與國際安全相關會議。
此次會議正值AI產業對先進技術風險的討論升溫之際，數週前已有多名AI業界領袖呼籲協調放慢技術開發速度，並警告AI可能很快具備自行改進的能力，進而脫離人類控制。
外交人士透露，AI公司Anthropic也可能派遣高層出席會議，但目前尚未獲得確認。Anthropic尚未立即回應置評要求。
此次會議由9月輪值安理會主席國法國召集，並由法國歐洲暨外交部長巴羅（Jean-Noël Barrot）主持。
法國向安理會成員散發的會議概念文件指出，鑑於AI遭到濫用、用於惡意目的的風險，並考慮到安理會過去在此領域的參與，法國希望強調，國際社會迫切需要採取行動，推動安全且負責任的AI發展，以造福整個國際社會。
法國在會議概念文件中表示，此次會議旨在讓與會者「提出對失去控制或利用最新AI模型開發、促成及執行可能影響國際安全與和平之行動等相關風險的分析」。
負責維護國際和平與安全的聯合國安理會，早在2023年便首次針對AI風險召開會議。當時，中國警告AI不應成為「脫韁野馬」；美國則提醒，AI不應被用於審查或壓制民眾。
奧特曼早在當前AI熱潮興起前，就曾公開警告相關技術可能帶來的風險。他在2015年發表的文章《Machine Intelligence, part 1》中指出，超越人類的機器智慧可能是人類延續生存所面臨的最大威脅。
paras_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman will brief the United Nations Security Council during the UN General Assembly in New York next week, when world leaders gather in the city for the annual meeting.
According to Reuters, an OpenAI spokesperson said on Friday (the 18th) that Altman will personally present at an open session of the Security Council next week.
The Security Council, composed of 15 member states, is scheduled to hold a meeting on AI and international security on Wednesday (the 23rd).

The meeting comes as discussions about the risks of advanced AI technologies are heating up, with several industry leaders having called weeks ago for coordinated slowing of development and warning that AI could soon gain the ability to improve itself and slip out of human control.
Diplomats said AI firm Anthropic may also send senior executives to the meeting, though this has not yet been confirmed. Anthropic did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
The session is being convened by France, the rotating Security Council president for September, and will be chaired by French European and Foreign Affairs Minister Jean‑Noël Barrot.

In a concept note circulated to Council members, France noted the risk of AI misuse for malicious purposes and, given the Council’s past involvement in the area, emphasized the urgent need for the international community to act to promote safe and responsible AI development for the benefit of all.

France’s concept note states that the meeting aims to have participants "present analyses of the risks associated with loss of control or the use of the latest AI models to develop, facilitate, or execute actions that could affect international security and peace."

The UN Security Council, which is tasked with maintaining international peace and security, first held a meeting on AI risks back in 2023. At that time, China warned that AI should not become a "runaway horse," while the United States cautioned that AI should not be used for censorship or repression of people.

Altman warned about AI risks long before the current hype. In a 2015 article titled "Machine Intelligence, part 1," he wrote that super‑human machine intelligence could represent the greatest threat to humanity’s continued survival.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro開賣！分析師挺蘋果：換機周期優於預期 股價有13%上漲空間
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Goes on Sale! Analysts Back Apple: Upgrade Cycle Better Than Expected, Stock Has About 13% Upside
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)最新一波iPhone產品採取全高階機款策略，這項做法雖然具有風險，但Evercore ISI分析師認為，這項策略最終將有利於蘋果營收與股價表現。
Evercore ISI分析師Amit Daryanani周五(18日)將蘋果目標價從365美元提升至380美元，較蘋果周四收盤價每股337美元還有約13%的上漲空間。蘋果周五終場下跌0.7%，收在每股334.64美元。
Evercore在完成對約4000名消費者的年度iPhone購買意願調查後，認為iPhone換機周期可能優於預期，因而做出最新預測。
Daryanani寫道：「需求似乎略優於去年，這可能讓iPhone在強勁的升級周期後，迎來另一波成長。」他給予蘋果「優於大盤」的評等。

iPhone 18 Pro先上市 標準版明春推出

iPhone 18 Pro與iPhone 18 Pro Max在上周的蘋果發表會首次亮相，本周五正式在門市與線上通路開賣。
蘋果今年作風與以往不同，iPhone 18系列只先推出高階Pro機型，而華爾街預期，蘋果將在明年春季推出iPhone 18標準款。以往的蘋果會在同一時間推出新iPhone的四款機型。
高價手機如果能熱賣，將有利於蘋果營收與利潤率，但這項策略也存在風險。iPhone 18 Pro系列售價較前代高出100美元，雖然是為了因應持續的記憶體成本危機才調漲價格，這可能對市場需求造成壓力。

電信商提高優惠 抵銷蘋果漲價壓力

美銀證券(BofA Securities)分析師Wamsi Mohan周四在報告中指出，美國無線電信商已提高購買iPhone的優惠幅度，此舉「大致抵銷了蘋果今年的漲價」。他給予蘋果「買進」評等，目標價370美元。
其他分析師同樣看好iPhone 18 Pro銷售。摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)分析師Erik Woodring周三在報告中指出，iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max的交貨等待時間，也就是消費者下單至收到產品所需的時間，顯示這兩款手機的「潛在需求更健康」。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is launching its latest wave of iPhone products with an all‑premium‑model strategy. While this approach carries risk, Evercore ISI analyst believes it will ultimately benefit Apple’s revenue and stock performance.

Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani raised Apple’s target price on Friday (the 18th) from $365 to $380, implying roughly a 13% upside from Apple’s Thursday close of $337 per share. Apple closed Friday down 0.7% at $334.64 per share.
After completing its annual iPhone purchase‑intent survey of about 4,000 consumers, Evercore sees the iPhone upgrade cycle potentially outpacing expectations, prompting its latest forecast.

Daryanani wrote, “Demand appears slightly stronger than last year, which could give the iPhone another growth wave after a robust upgrade cycle.” He assigned Apple an “out‑perform” rating relative to the broader market.

The iPhone 18 Pro launches first, with the standard model slated for next spring. The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max debuted at Apple’s event last week and went on sale in stores and online on Friday.

Apple’s approach this year differs from the past: the iPhone 18 series is being introduced with only the high‑end Pro models, while Wall Street expects the standard iPhone 18 to arrive in spring next year. Historically, Apple released all four new iPhone models simultaneously.

If the high‑priced phones sell well, they will boost Apple’s revenue and profit margins, but the strategy also carries risk. The iPhone 18 Pro series is priced about $100 higher than its predecessor, a hike driven by ongoing memory‑cost pressures that could weigh on demand.

Bank of America Securities analyst Wamsi Mohan noted on Thursday that U.S. wireless carriers have increased iPhone purchase incentives, a move that “largely offsets Apple’s price hikes this year.” He gave Apple a “Buy” rating with a $370 target price.

Other analysts are similarly optimistic about iPhone 18 Pro sales. Morgan Stanley analyst Erik Woodring said on Wednesday that the delivery wait times for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max—i.e., the time from order to receipt—indicate “healthier underlying demand” for the two models.

items.title: 高市早苗搶在川習會前見川普！聚焦中國、貿易及伊朗戰爭
items.title_en: Sanae Takayoshi Meets Trump Before His Japan‑China Summit, Focusing on China, Trade and the Iran War
paras: 美國總統川普預計下週在紐約出席聯合國大會期間，與日本首相高市早苗舉行會談。這將是美國介入協助穩定日元匯率後，兩國領袖首度面對面交流，雙方預料將討論對中政策、貿易及伊朗戰爭等議題。
根據《彭博》報導，美國駐聯合國大使Mike Waltz週五（18日）向媒體透露，川普將在聯大會議期間與高市早苗會面。
美日兩國政府7月底曾聯手買進日元，協助穩定匯率。當時日元兌美元一度貶至接近164日元，創下近40年來低點。這是美日自1998年以來首度協同干預匯市。
美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）本週為這項行動辯護，表示日元走強有利於美國出口，也能降低日本為支撐本國貨幣而出售美國資產的需求。
據日本媒體先前報導，高市早苗安排與川普會面，可能是希望在川普與中國國家主席習近平會晤前，先就對中政策交換意見。
除中國議題外，雙方也可能討論貿易及伊朗戰爭。美日去年達成關稅休戰協議，其中包括日本承諾設立規模5500億美元的投資基金。
高市早苗也一直尋求強化日本軍事能力，以因應中國在區域內的影響力。川普則曾肯定日本採購美國國防裝備的做法。
不過，伊朗戰事已成為日美關係中的摩擦點。川普今年稍早曾對包括日本在內的盟友未回應其協助重新開放荷姆茲海峽的軍事支援要求表達不滿。
高市早苗3月與川普會面時，曾強調日本承諾增加採購美國石油。由於中東戰事衝擊全球能源供應，日本幾乎完全依賴進口石油，能源價格上漲對日本的影響尤其顯著。
川普與高市早苗關係友好。不過，兩人3月會面時，川普在回答伊朗戰爭相關問題時，提及日本偷襲珍珠港、促使美國加入第二次世界大戰的歷史事件。
當時，高市早苗被拍到抿嘴並轉頭看向幕僚。儘管如此，她仍多次感謝川普對日美同盟的支持。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump is expected to meet Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takayoshi next week in New York during the United Nations General Assembly, marking the first face‑to‑face exchange between the two leaders since the United States intervened to help stabilize the yen. Both sides anticipate discussing policy toward China, trade and the war in Iran.
According to Bloomberg, U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz told reporters on Friday (the 18th) that Trump will meet Takayoshi during the UNGA session.

In late July, the U.S. and Japanese governments jointly bought yen to help steady the currency after it slipped to near ¥164 per dollar, a near‑40‑year low. It was the first coordinated foreign‑exchange intervention by the two countries since 1998.
U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent defended the move this week, saying a stronger yen benefits U.S. exporters and reduces Japan’s need to sell U.S. assets to support its own currency.
Japanese media previously reported that Takayoshi’s arrangement to meet Trump may be intended to exchange views on China policy before Trump meets Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Beyond China, the two are also likely to discuss trade and the Iran war. Last year the U.S. and Japan reached a tariff‑freeze agreement that includes Japan’s pledge to set up a $550 billion investment fund.
Takayoshi has been pushing to strengthen Japan’s military capability to counter China’s regional influence, and Trump has praised Japan’s purchases of U.S. defense equipment.

However, the Iran conflict has become a friction point in U.S.–Japan relations. Earlier this year Trump expressed frustration that allies, including Japan, had not responded to his request for military support to reopen the Hormuz Strait.

When Takayoshi met Trump in March, she emphasized Japan’s commitment to increase purchases of U.S. oil. With the Middle‑East war disrupting global energy supplies, Japan—almost wholly dependent on imported oil—feels the impact of rising energy prices acutely.

Trump and Takayoshi enjoy a friendly rapport. Yet during their March meeting, when asked about the Iran war, Trump referenced Japan’s surprise attack on Pearl Harbor that drew the United States into World War II.
At that moment Takayoshi was seen pursing her lips and turning her head toward her staff. Nevertheless, she repeatedly thanked Trump for his support of the U.S.–Japan alliance.
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: Anthropic引進第三方安全評估！埃森哲消弭AI取代疑慮 盤後飆漲8%
items.title_en: Anthropic Introduces Third-Party Safety Assessment! Accenture Eases AI Replacement Concerns, Shares Jump 8% After Hours
paras: Anthropic宣布將與科技顧問商埃森哲(Accenture)(ACN-US)合作，推動人工智慧(AI)安全評估，帶動其股價周五(18日)盤後大漲，擺脫近期歷經的劇烈跌勢。
雙方將在Anthropic內部進駐一支獨立安全評估團隊，由Accenture旗下專精AI業務的Faculty主導這項合作。兩家公司預估未來五年至少投資10億美元在AI安全評估上。
Accenture股價周五盤後跳漲8%。該股周五稍早正常交易時段下跌4.7%至每股181.29美元，主因Guggenheim分析師調降評等。

AI安全疑慮升溫 Anthropic要求放慢開發速度

雙方合作正值全美AI安全討論升溫之際。今年夏季，數百個OpenAI自主AI代理人攻入OpenAI內部系統以及開發者平台Hugging Face，引起注目。接著上周一名Anthropic研究員辭職，並發文指責整個AI產業推進AI發展的速度不負責任，使相關疑慮進一步演變成危機。
Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)隨後呼籲放慢AI開發速度，並要求AI公司引入第三方評估機制。
目前還不清楚這些評估人員將如何運作，也尚未確定具體人選，Anthropic表示，目前正與研究型非營利組織METR及其他非營利評估機構洽談。
Anthropic在公告中表示：「嵌入式評估是一項新做法，許多運作細節仍在制定中。」
Anthropic指出，與目前的外部評估人員不同，嵌入式評估人員將直接在AI公司內部工作，並擁有與公司員工相近的存取權限。

AI安全業務 可能成為Accenture股價新助力

Anthropic與Accenture的合作並非排他性合作，Anthropic表示，預期Accenture也將以類似方式與其他AI開發商合作。
這項潛在的新業務，代表Accenture的AI題材可能出現重大轉折。該公司今年來股價下跌32%，投資人一直擔心AI工具可能降低企業對顧問服務的需求。
但《巴隆周刊》指出，如果Accenture能在AI安全業務中扮演領導角色，AI可能不再是該公司的阻力，反而可能成為推升股價的助力。
paras_en: Anthropic announced it will partner with technology consulting firm Accenture (ACN-US) to promote AI safety assessments, driving its stock to surge after hours on Friday the 18th, shedding the recent steep decline.

The two parties will embed an independent safety assessment team within Anthropic, led by Accenture’s AI-focused Faculty unit. The companies estimate they will invest at least $1 billion over the next five years in AI safety assessments.
Accenture’s shares jumped 8% after hours on Friday. Earlier in the regular trading session the stock fell 4.7% to $181.29 per share, mainly because a Guggenheim analyst downgraded its rating.

AI safety concerns are rising; Anthropic calls for slower development. The collaboration comes as AI safety discussions heat up across the U.S. This summer, hundreds of autonomous OpenAI agents breached OpenAI’s internal systems and the developer platform Hugging Face, drawing attention. Then last Monday an Anthropic researcher resigned and posted that the entire AI industry is advancing development at an irresponsible pace, turning the concerns into a crisis.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei subsequently urged a slowdown in AI development and called for AI companies to adopt third‑party assessment mechanisms.

It is still unclear how these assessors will operate, and no specific personnel have been identified yet; Anthropic said it is in talks with the research nonprofit METR and other nonprofit assessment organizations.
In the announcement, Anthropic said: “Embedded assessment is a new approach, and many operational details are still being defined.”
Anthropic noted that unlike current external assessors, embedded assessors will work directly inside the AI company and will have access rights comparable to those of company employees.

AI safety business could become a new driver for Accenture’s stock. The partnership with Anthropic is not exclusive; Anthropic expects Accenture will work with other AI developers in a similar manner.

This potential new line of business could represent a major turning point for Accenture’s AI theme. The company’s stock has fallen 32% this year, and investors have been worried that AI tools might reduce demand for consulting services.
But Barron’s noted that if Accenture can play a leading role in AI safety, AI may no longer be a drag on the company but rather a boost to its share price.

items.title: 智寶首度進軍好萊塢 《電鋸甜心》啟動真人版電影計畫
items.title_en: ZhiBao Enters Hollywood for the First Time, Launches Live‑Action Film Project for "Lollipop Chainsaw"
paras: 動漫遊戲(ACG)IP公司智寶(7824-TW)擴大全球 IP 計畫，繼正式公開《電鋸甜心2》遊戲開發計畫後，接力宣布將推進《LollipopChainsaw 電鋸甜心》真人版電影及動畫拍攝計畫，也是公司IP首度進軍好萊塢。
智寶總經理鄧橋表示，《電鋸甜心》具備成為經典娛樂品牌的所有要素，因此透過與跨國夥伴們合作，製作出世界級的遊戲、動畫與真人影視作品。其中，《電鋸甜心》真人版電影將為延續原作世界觀的全新原創故事，時間軸設定於原作遊戲事件之前，目前選角大致底定，明年開始拍攝及動畫後製，智寶最快明年可開始認列授權金，後續上映後則可認列票房分潤。

鄧橋進一步指出，《電鋸甜心》全球 IP 計畫已正式進入跨國團隊協作與跨載體同步推進的階段，主要參與方包括IP 原作版權DRAGAMI GAMES、IP 計畫統籌智寶、遊戲製作JP UNIVERSE、影視開發Ambitious Entertainment/Non Stop Studios/Orange Chariot/Throne、策略投資包括台灣大哥大(3045-TW)、威剛(3260-TW)、影一製作所等。
《電鋸甜心》首部真人版電影由智寶主動發起，集結好萊塢規格的歐美電影製作團隊，由5位製作人共同操刀，除了鄧橋外，還有Throne執行長結城崇史、Orange Chariot 共同創辦人Robert Franke、Ambitious Entertainment 執行長 Kirk Shaw，以及 Non Stop Studios Corp. 總裁Patricio Rabuffetti。

團隊陣容具備了豐沛的國際影視製作實績，Kirk Shaw 為好萊塢最具產量與實績的製作人之一，累計操刀 250 部以上電影與7部電視影集，曾任奧斯卡金像獎得獎作品《危機倒數》（The Hurt Locker）副製作人；Patricio Rabuffetti 所帶領的 Non Stop 擁有逾25年經驗、整合歐美20家以上公司的影音價值鏈網絡；Robert Franke 曾操刀與富士電視台、HuluJapan 共製合作影集。
paras_en: Animation‑game (ACG) IP company ZhiBao (7824‑TW) is expanding its global IP program. After officially announcing the development of the "Lollipop Chainsaw 2" game, the company now reveals plans to advance a live‑action film and animation production for "Lollipop Chainsaw," marking its first foray into Hollywood for the IP.

General manager Deng Qiao said that "Lollipop Chainsaw" has all the ingredients to become a classic entertainment brand, and through cooperation with multinational partners it will be turned into world‑class games, animation and live‑action audiovisual works. The live‑action film will tell an original story that continues the original universe but is set before the events of the game. Casting is largely settled, filming and animation post‑production will begin next year, and ZhiBao could start recognizing licensing fees as early as next year, with box‑office revenue sharing to be recorded after the film’s release.

Deng further noted that the global IP plan for "Lollipop Chainsaw" has entered a stage of cross‑border team collaboration and multi‑platform simultaneous development. Key participants include the IP original rights holder DRAGAMI GAMES, ZhiBao as the IP project coordinator, game developer JP UNIVERSE, film‑TV developers Ambitious Entertainment, Non Stop Studios and Orange Chariot, as well as strategic investors such as Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW), ADATA (3260‑TW) and Ying‑One Production.

The first live‑action movie for "Lollipop Chainsaw" is being initiated by ZhiBao, assembling a Hollywood‑standard European‑American production team. Five producers are steering the project: besides Deng Qiao, there are Throne CEO Takashi Yuki, Orange Chariot co‑founder Robert Franke, Ambitious Entertainment CEO Kirk Shaw, and Non Stop Studios Corp. President Patricio Rabuffetti.

The team brings extensive international film‑production credentials. Kirk Shaw is one of Hollywood’s most prolific producers, having overseen more than 250 films and seven TV series and serving as associate producer on the Oscar‑winning "The Hurt Locker." Patricio Rabuffetti’s Non Stop Studios boasts over 25 years of experience and a media‑value‑chain network that integrates more than 20 European and American companies. Robert Franke has produced co‑productions with Fuji TV and Hulu Japan.

items.title: 志聖慶一甲子家庭日逾800人同歡　加發4000萬元獎金感謝同仁
items.title_en: Zhi Sheng Celebrates 60th Anniversary Family Day with Over 800 Participants, Grants Additional NT$40 Million Bonus to Thank Employees
paras: 台積電(2467-TW)供應鏈志聖工業(2467-TW)今(19)日舉辦60周年家庭日盛事，林口、台中廠員工與眷屬逾800人齊聚桃園六福村，共同歡慶一甲子里程碑。董事長梁茂生、梁又文現場宣布，公司將加發總額4000萬元獎金，感謝全體同仁今年的努力，也感謝家人長期在背後支持。
志聖董事長梁茂生、總經理梁又文指出，志聖走過60年，最珍貴的力量始終來自「人」，每一項成果都有同仁的投入，也有家人在背後一路相伴。
PCB及半導體設備廠的志聖，力在今天晚間的「點亮60」星光音樂會中特別播放以《禮運大同篇》為歌詞重新演繹的志聖60週年《孔子之歌》，傳遞文化傳承與人本價值；孫淑媚、魏如昀、李聖傑也接力演出，與同仁及家屬共享60周年的喜悅。
志聖026年1-8月營收70.77億元，已經超越2025年全年，年增83.37%。志聖 2026 上半年營收 50.44 億元，較去年同期成長 78.92%；歸屬母公司業主稅後純益 11.06 億元，年增 2.09 倍，每股純益 7.16 元。
paras_en: TSMC (2467‑TW) supply‑chain partner Zhi Sheng Industrial (2467‑TW) held a grand 60th‑anniversary family day today (19th), bringing together more than 800 employees and their families from the Linkou and Taichung plants at Taoyuan’s Leofoo Village to celebrate the six‑decade milestone. Chairmen Liang Maosheng and Liang Youwen announced on site that the company will issue an additional total bonus of NT$40 million to thank all staff for their efforts this year and to appreciate families for their long‑standing support behind the scenes.

Chairman Liang Maosheng and General Manager Liang Youwen noted that after 60 years, Zhi Sheng’s most valuable strength has always come from “people”; every achievement reflects the dedication of employees and the continuous support of their families.

At tonight’s “Light Up 60” star‑filled concert, Zhi Sheng— a PCB and semiconductor equipment manufacturer— specially performed a re‑interpreted “Confucius Song” for its 60th anniversary, using lyrics from the “Li Yun Da Tong” piece to convey cultural heritage and human‑centric values. Performers Sun Shumei, Wei Ruyun and Li Shengjie also took the stage, sharing the joy of the 60th anniversary with colleagues and their families.

Zhi Sheng’s revenue for January‑August 2026 was NT$7.077 billion, already surpassing the full‑year 2025 figure, an 83.37% year‑over‑year increase. For the first half of 2026, revenue reached NT$5.044 billion, up 78.92% from the same period last year; net profit attributable to the parent company was NT$1.106 billion, a 2.09‑fold increase year‑over‑year, and earnings per share were NT$7.16.

items.title: 〈房產〉永和大陳公辦都更再向前推進 漢皇建設單元7今啟動拆除
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Yonghe Da Chen Public Urban Renewal Project Advances Again, Hanhuang Construction Unit 7 Begins Demolition Today
paras: 新北市政府辦理的「永和新生地（大陳地區）更新單元7公辦都更案」今(19)日上午舉行拆除動工典禮，大陳公辦都更案是全台最大、最複雜困難的公辦都市更新計畫，這也是漢皇繼永和大陳單元6「漢皇River Sky」傳熱銷佳績，今年再度推進永和重大更新進程。
永和大陳地區更新單元7面積約1.34公頃，新北市府自2021年完成招商，由漢皇建設擔任實施者後，團隊積極推動相關作業；本案約歷經2年完成審議核定，進入拆除階段，象徵大陳地區都市更新再向前邁進，此次拆除動工不僅代表更新工程正式啟動，
大陳地區更新單元7案建築設計以環境永續與公共利益為核心，規劃黃金級綠建築、黃金級智慧建築、無障礙環境設計及耐震標章，並提供市民活動中心及社會住宅，打造永和地區嶄新的宜居環境，預計於2031年讓住戶入住新居。而漢皇建設可售總銷達255億元，規劃爲2-4房格局。
漢皇單元7的都更面積含道路用地面積3805坪，扣除道路面積3793坪。若連同單元六「漢皇River Sky」，扣除道路面積合計達6960坪。單元7規劃1515戶，三棟規劃地上36樓，地下6層。
漢皇集團後續預計推案則包括，頂溪門戶計畫、懷生段、三興段、塭仔圳、光復街東側、秀北段、水源段、南山段等個案，總銷預計突破1000億元。
paras_en: The New Taipei City Government’s "Yonghe New Life (Da Chen Area) Urban Renewal Unit 7 Public Project" held a demolition groundbreaking ceremony this morning (19th). The Da Chen public urban renewal project is the largest and most complex public urban renewal plan in Taiwan, and this marks Hanhuang’s continued push on the major Yonghe renewal process after the strong sales performance of Unit 6 "Hanhuang River Sky".

Unit 7 of the Yonghe Da Chen area covers about 1.34 hectares. After the city completed the investment solicitation in 2021 and appointed Hanhuang Construction as the implementer, the team has been actively advancing related work. The case took roughly two years to complete review and approval and has now entered the demolition phase, symbolizing another step forward for Da Chen’s urban renewal. This demolition start not only signals the official launch of the renewal works,

The architectural design of Unit 7 in the Da Chen area centers on environmental sustainability and public interest, planning gold‑standard green buildings, gold‑standard smart buildings, barrier‑free environments, and seismic‑resistance certification. It will also provide a community activity center and social housing to create a brand‑new livable environment in Yonghe, with residents expected to move into new homes by 2031. Hanhuang Construction’s total sales potential for the project reaches NT$25.5 billion, featuring 2‑ to 4‑room layouts.

Hanhuang’s Unit 7 renewal area includes 3,805 ping of road land, with 3,793 ping of road area deducted. When combined with Unit 6 "Hanhuang River Sky", the total road‑deducted area reaches 6,960 ping. Unit 7 plans for 1,515 households, with three buildings each rising 36 floors above ground and six basement levels.

Hanhuang Group’s subsequent projects are expected to include the Dingxi Gateway Project, Huaisheng Section, Sanxing Section, Wenzai Canal, East Side of Guangfu Street, Xiubei Section, Water Source Section, and Nanshan Section, with total sales projected to exceed NT$100 billion.

items.title: 美光勞資談判觸及三議題 10/22再舉行第二次會議
items.title_en: Micron Labor Negotiations Cover Three Issues; Second Meeting Scheduled for Oct. 22
paras: 美光(MU-US)台灣與台灣美光記憶體工會於昨日舉行首次調解會議，美光今(19)日表示，雙方進行有建設性且助於推進溝通的討論，並同意於 10 月 22 日舉行第二次調解會議。雙方感謝中部科學園區管理局(CTSP)及調解委員會在本次調解過程中所提供的協助與支持。
美光勞資雙方在此次會議中，就多項議題進行討論，包括整體獎酬與獎金制度架構、禁搭便車(No Free Rider)議題，以及禁止秋後算賬(Non-Retaliation)等。
有關最後一項，美光再次重申公司的承諾，正如《美光全球團隊成員手冊》中所載明，團隊成員有權在不必擔心遭受報復的情況下，和平集會、自由結社、成立及加入其自行選擇的工會或勞工組織，並尋求集體協商或其他形式的代表權。
雙方將持續秉持相互尊重的精神，透過正向、務實的溝通，支持員工、服務客戶，並共同促進公司的持續成功。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) and the Taiwan Micron Memory Workers Union held their first mediation meeting in Taiwan yesterday. Micron announced on the 19th that the discussion was constructive and helped advance communication, and both parties agreed to hold a second mediation meeting on October 22. The parties thanked the Central Taiwan Science Park Administration (CTSP) and the mediation committee for their assistance and support during the process.
During the meeting, Micron and the union discussed several matters, including the overall compensation and bonus structure, the No Free Rider issue, and the prohibition of non‑retaliation practices.

Regarding the last item, Micron reiterated its commitment, as stated in the Micron Global Team Member Handbook, that team members have the right to peacefully assemble, freely associate, form and join unions or labor organizations of their choosing, and seek collective bargaining or other forms of representation without fear of retaliation.

Both sides will continue to uphold a spirit of mutual respect, engage in positive and pragmatic communication, support employees and serve customers, and jointly promote the company’s ongoing success.

items.title: 財部出重拳！宣布對印印馬越4國陶瓷面磚展開反傾銷落日調查 最快明年5月定案
items.title_en: Finance Ministry Takes Strong Action! Announces Anti-Dumping Sunset Investigation on Ceramic Facing Tiles from India, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia – Decision Could Be Made as Early as May Next Year
paras: 財政部關務署昨（18）日表示，對自印度、越南、馬來西亞及印尼產製進口陶瓷面磚繼續課徵反傾銷稅案，今公告進行落日調查，並需在6個月內完成傾銷調查認定，加以經濟部的產業損害認定應於2個月內完成，最快於明年5月下旬定案，以維護國內產業公平合理貿易環境，保護本土業者發展。

關務署說明，台灣於2021年9月27日公告對自印度、越南、馬來西亞及印尼產製進口陶瓷面磚課徵反傾銷稅，並自2021年10月4日起實施，課徵期間將於2026年10月3日屆滿5年。財政部先前於2026年3月4日公告，國內同類貨物產業代表如認為有繼續課徵之必要者，得於公告翌日起1個月內提出申請。原案申請人台灣陶瓷工業同業公會及冠軍 (1806-TW) 等6家公司已於2026年4月2日提出繼續課徵之申請。
關務署進一步說明，依據申請人提供之資料，可合理懷疑如停止對涉案貨物課徵反傾銷稅，傾銷及損害可能繼續或再度發生，因此財政部決定依法進行調查。
針對本案之調查程序及時限，依據平衡稅及反傾銷稅課徵實施辦法第44條第4項規定，財政部應自公告進行調查之日起6個月內完成傾銷調查認定，並通知經濟部；經濟部應自公告進行調查之日起展開產業損害調查，於接獲財政部通知之翌日起2個月內完成認定，並通知財政部。財政部則應於接獲經濟部通知之翌日起10日內，提交該部關稅稅率審議小組審議是否繼續課徵反傾銷稅。
paras_en: The Ministry of Finance Customs Administration announced on the 18th that it will continue to impose anti-dumping duties on ceramic facing tiles imported from India, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia, and will conduct a sunset investigation. The investigation must be completed within six months, and the Ministry of Economic Affairs must determine industry damage within two months. The earliest decision could be made in late May next year to protect domestic industry and ensure fair trade.

The Customs Administration explained that Taiwan announced anti-dumping duties on ceramic facing tiles from India, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia on September 27, 2021, and implemented them from October 4, 2021, for a five‑year period ending October 3, 2026. On March 4, 2026, the Ministry of Finance announced that domestic industry representatives could apply for continued duties within one month of the announcement. The original applicants—Taiwan Ceramic Industry Association and six companies including Champion (1806‑TW)—submitted their request for continued duties on April 2, 2026.

The Customs Administration further clarified that, based on the information provided by the applicants, it is reasonably suspected that if duties on the implicated goods were stopped, dumping and damage could continue or recur. Therefore, the Ministry of Finance decided to conduct a legal investigation.

Regarding the investigation procedure and timeline, Article 44(4) of the Implementation Rules for Tariff and Anti‑Dumping Duties states that the Ministry of Finance must complete the anti‑dumping investigation within six months of announcing the investigation and notify the Ministry of Economic Affairs. The Ministry of Economic Affairs must begin an industry damage investigation within two months of receiving the Ministry of Finance’s notification and notify the Ministry of Finance. The Ministry of Finance must then submit a review to the Tariff Rate Review Committee within ten days of receiving the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ notification to decide whether to continue the anti‑dumping duties.

items.title: 亞運看合庫！周天成、林昀儒、鄭怡靜等20菁英全力爭金 「加薪晉升」激勵爭光
items.title_en: Asian Games Spotlight on Heku! Zhou Tiancheng, Lin Yun-ju, Zheng Yi-jing and 20 Elite Athletes Compete for Gold, Motivated by Salary Increases and Promotions
paras: 「2026 名古屋亞運」於今(19)  日正式揭開序幕，中華代表隊集結各項運動菁英前進名古屋，為國家爭取最高榮耀。合庫金控（5880-TW）旗下合作金庫參與本屆名古屋亞運的教練及選手合計共20位，桌球隊由蔣澎龍教練、吳文嘉教練、桌球一哥林昀儒、一姐鄭怡靜、馮翊新、郭冠宏、葉伊恬及徐絃家出賽；棒球隊由林加祐教練、陳孝允、王政浩、林佾葳、李亦崴、高育瑋及楊振裕出賽；羽球隊則由羽球一哥周天成、王子維、李哲輝、楊博軒及胡綾芳出賽，三支球隊選手將在名古屋亞運全力以赴、勇創佳績、為國爭光。

合庫長期投入國家體育發展，持續深耕基層體育、培育優秀運動人才，提供球員比照行員待遇的薪資、獎金及各項福利，除了每月發放營養費外，更致力打造完善的訓練環境，協助選手無後顧之憂地投入各項運動賽事，此次多位合庫選手能入選名古屋亞運中華代表隊，更是展現了合庫長期推動體育發展的豐碩成果。合庫建置完整的球員獎勵制度，選手代表國家參加大型賽事若表現優異，除了激勵獎金、記功與加薪，每月還會加碼營養費，並給予晉升職等的機會，以實質福利給予球員最大的支持與鼓勵。
合庫秉持「取之於社會，用之於社會」的精神，積極響應金管會「金融大回饋」政策，自民國36年成立第一支桌球隊至今已近80年，合庫始終相信體育是讓台灣與國際接軌的關鍵軟實力，並以實際行動支持體育，每年編列充足預算，持續支持桌球、棒球及羽球三支球隊，陪伴選手逐夢、站上國際舞台發光發熱，提高台灣的體育實力及國際能見度。
paras_en: The "2026 Nagoya Asian Games" officially kicked off today (the 19th), with the Chinese delegation gathering elite athletes across various sports to compete in Nagoya for the nation's highest honor. Heku Financial Holding (5880-TW) subsidiary Heku Bank has a total of 20 coaches and athletes participating in these Games: the table tennis team, coached by Jiang Penglong and Wu Wenjia, includes star player Lin Yun-ju, top female player Zheng Yi-jing, Feng Yixin, Guo Guanhong, Ye Yitian and Xu Xianjia; the baseball team, coached by Lin Jiayou, features Chen Xiaoyun, Wang Zhenghao, Lin Yiwei, Li Yiwei, Gao Yuwei and Yang Zhenyu; the badminton team includes top shuttler Zhou Tiancheng, Wang Ziwei, Li Zhehui, Yang Boxuan and Hu Linfang. These three squads will give their all at the Nagoya Asian Games, striving for outstanding results and national pride.

Heku has long invested in national sports development, continuously nurturing grassroots athletics and cultivating outstanding talent. It provides players with salaries, bonuses and benefits comparable to bank staff, including monthly nutrition allowances, and works to create a comprehensive training environment so athletes can focus on competition without worries. The selection of multiple Heku athletes for the Chinese delegation to Nagoya showcases the fruitful results of Heku’s sustained sports promotion. Heku has established a complete player reward system: athletes representing the country in major events who perform well receive incentive bonuses, commendations and salary raises, additional monthly nutrition allowances, and opportunities for promotion, offering the greatest support and encouragement through tangible benefits.

Upholding the principle of "taking from society, giving back to society," Heku actively responds to the Financial Supervisory Commission’s “Financial Big Return” policy. Since founding its first table tennis team in the 36th year of the Republic (1997), nearly 80 years ago, Heku has always believed sports are a key soft power linking Taiwan with the world. It supports sports with concrete actions, allocating ample annual budgets to continuously back its table tennis, baseball and badminton teams, accompanying athletes as they chase their dreams and shine on the international stage, thereby enhancing Taiwan’s athletic strength and global visibility.

items.title: 手把手教你AI+期貨！期交所首開「AI智能交易」實戰課9/22首發 即起報名開搶
items.title_en: Step‑by‑Step Guide to AI + Futures: TAIFEX Launches First "AI Smart Trading" Practical Course on September 22
paras: 台灣期貨交易所持續推出一系列「期貨及選擇權」課程，協助交易人建構完善交易觀念並因應金融科技趨勢。課程涵蓋基礎與進階內容，採實體與線上直播雙軌進行。進階課程將於9月22日及24日開講，10月至12月則推出最新一季基礎課程，即日起全面開放網路報名。
每月期交所邀請業界講師講授基礎課程，從基本的期貨與選擇權養成出發，並配合講師專長設計不同主題。最新一季課程即將於10月至12月登場，本次特色除保留期貨與選擇權基礎介紹與風險管理教學外，更加入自動化交易應用、極端行情部位停損策略、VIX波動率指標與期權交易SOP建立等實務內容，全方位協助交易人掌握策略與風險控管，完整課綱及開課日期詳見期交所官網公告。

進階課程則隨著程式交易與人工智慧應用普及，聚焦於「AI智能交易於期貨市場之策略應用」，課程將於9月22日及24日舉辦。內容規劃從大數據蒐集與AI情緒分析出發，引導學員運用Python與LLM API自動抓取財經資訊並評估市場情緒；接著進入MultiCharts策略建置與跨系統串接，藉由AI將主觀交易邏輯轉化為程式語法，將數據即時匯入作為風控濾網；最後透過API串接與雲端下單防護，協助學員完成API下單串接，建立雲端部位對齊防錯與斷線通報機制，打造結合AI與自動化交易的實戰教學。
本次課程提供雙軌學習，課後搭配期交所影音知識網與虛擬交易所等數位工具，提供完整自學與進階資源，協助交易人建立屬於自己的交易優勢。所有課程採網路報名，詳細課程大綱與報名資訊請至期交所官網（http://www.taifex.com.tw）「教育宣導報名及活動專區」查詢。
paras_en: The Taiwan Futures Exchange (TAIFEX) continues to roll out a series of "Futures and Options" courses to help traders build comprehensive trading concepts and adapt to fintech trends. The courses cover both basic and advanced content and are offered in both in‑person and online live‑stream formats. Advanced courses will begin on September 22 and 24, while a new basic‑course cohort will run from October to December, with online registration now open to all.

Each month TAIFEX invites industry lecturers to teach basic courses, starting from the fundamentals of futures and options and tailoring topics to the lecturer’s expertise. The upcoming October‑December cohort will retain the core introductions to futures, options, and risk management, while adding practical modules on automated trading applications, stop‑loss strategies for extreme market conditions, VIX volatility indicators, and SOPs for option trading. These additions aim to give traders a comprehensive toolkit for strategy execution and risk control; the full syllabus and start dates are listed on the TAIFEX website.

The advanced courses focus on the growing use of algorithmic trading and artificial intelligence in the futures market, with a theme of "AI Smart Trading Strategies in Futures Markets." Scheduled for September 22 and 24, the curriculum starts with big‑data collection and AI sentiment analysis, guiding participants to use Python and LLM APIs to automatically fetch financial news and gauge market sentiment. It then moves to building MultiCharts strategies and cross‑system integration, translating subjective trading logic into code and feeding real‑time data into risk‑control filters. Finally, participants learn to connect APIs and secure cloud‑based order execution, establishing cloud‑position alignment, error‑proofing, and disconnection notifications for a hands‑on AI‑driven automated trading workshop.

The program offers a dual‑track learning path, supplemented by TAIFEX’s video knowledge portal and virtual trading platform, providing a complete self‑study and advanced resource suite to help traders develop their own competitive edge. All courses are open for online registration; detailed syllabi and enrollment information can be found on the TAIFEX website (http://www.taifex.com.tw) under the "Education and Promotion Registration & Events" section.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉測試介面族群輪動 雍智科技周漲29%站回季線
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Testing Interface Group Rotation, Yongzhi Technology Gains 29% This Week to Reclaim Quarterly Trendline
paras: AI晶片測試益趨複雜，帶動測試介面重要性攀升，相關族群近來強勢表態，除了漢測(7856-TW)、精測(6510-TW)與創新服務(7828-TW)等陸續上漲，雍智科技(6683-TW)本周突破盤整格局，大漲29.46%，週五終場收在1,670元，創下兩個月來新高價，也收復季線大關。
雍智科技近期受惠AI晶片需求旺盛，8月營收創下歷史新高，達2.33億元，月增1.36%，年增25.74%，累計前8月營收17.8億元，年增29.82%，也同步改寫同期新高。
展望今年，雍智科技已拿下Google TPU專案，尤其該產品為混針產品，單價相當高，預計今年下半年起可望逐步小量貢獻營收，並預期在明年顯著放量，為因應客戶訂單，雍智科技也在今年積極擴產，擴產幅度達50%。
雍智科技本周自低點反彈，隨後沿五日線上攻，週四一度達1,695元，週五收在1,670元，站回季線大關，以三大法人動向來看，外資與投信皆站買方，分別敲進306張、7張，自營商則逢高調節102張。
paras_en: AI chip testing is becoming increasingly complex, driving up the importance of testing interfaces. The related groups have recently shown strong performance. In addition to Han Test (7856-TW), Jing Test (6510-TW), and Innovation Services (7828-TW) gradually rising, Yongzhi Technology (6683-TW) broke out of a consolidation pattern this week, surging 29.46%. It closed at 1,670 TWD on Friday, setting a new two‑month high and reclaiming the quarterly trendline.

Yongzhi Technology has benefited from strong demand for AI chips. In August, its revenue reached a record high of 233 million TWD, up 1.36% month‑on‑month and 25.74% year‑on‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months totaled 1.78 billion TWD, up 29.82% year‑on‑year, also setting a new high for the period.

Looking ahead to this year, Yongzhi Technology has secured a Google TPU project. The product is a mixed‑precision device with a high unit price, and it is expected to contribute gradually to revenue from the second half of the year, with significant volume expected next year. To meet customer orders, Yongzhi Technology has been actively expanding production this year, increasing capacity by 50%.

Yongzhi Technology rebounded from its low point this week, then advanced above the five‑day moving average. On Thursday it briefly reached 1,695 TWD, and closed at 1,670 TWD on Friday, re‑establishing the quarterly trendline. According to the three major institutional flows, foreign investors and mutual funds were on the buying side, purchasing 306 and 7 contracts respectively, while proprietary traders adjusted 102 contracts on the upside.

items.title: 「AI股神」又出手了？SanDisk暴漲11%、記憶體和晶片股「短期選擇權」爆巨量
paras: 美國人工智慧（AI）與半導體類股近期出現大額短期期權交易，市場焦點再度轉向曾因高槓桿押注AI股票而聲名大噪的「AI股神」、避險基金Situational Awareness經理人Leopold Aschenbrenner。
週五（18日），約有9,600萬美元的看漲期權權利金集中流入SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 、美光科技(MU-US) 、英特爾(INTC-US) 及邁威爾科技(MRVL-US) 等4檔AI概念股。其中，SanDisk股價盤中一度大漲11%。
《CNBC》主持人Jim Cramer在社群平台X發文表示，這波交易讓他聯想到Aschenbrenner重新進場。
Aschenbrenner是OpenAI前核心研究員，也是AI主題避險基金Situational Awareness創辦人，過去曾因運用高槓桿大舉買進半導體與AI企業的短期看漲期權而受到市場關注。

近億美元看漲期權集中押注4檔AI股

根據ZeroHedge彙整的盤中交易數據，這批將於10月2日到期的看漲期權，交易內容如下：

美光：履約價1,000美元，約1萬張合約，權利金約4,400萬美元。
SanDisk：履約價1,600美元，約4,200張合約，權利金約4,100萬美元。
英特爾：履約價115美元，約2萬張合約，權利金約730萬美元。
邁威爾科技：履約價250美元，約3,500張合約，權利金約385萬美元。


交易發生時，SanDisk股價已高於期權履約價；美光股價則接近履約價，英特爾與邁威爾科技的履約價則略高於當時股價。
由於上述期權距離到期日僅剩約兩週，時間價值衰減及Gamma敏感度均相當高，標的股價若未能迅速朝有利方向移動，期權價值可能大幅縮水。
Cramer指出，這批期權的到期日落在美光公布第4季財報之後，而該財報受到整個記憶體產業關注。他早在8月便對記憶體類股抱持樂觀看法，認為AI資料中心需求及供應紀律，正改變記憶體產業過去景氣循環的運作模式。

交易標的與手法引發市場聯想

目前美國證券交易委員會（SEC）的申報文件尚未揭露這批期權的買家身分，但市場之所以猜測Aschenbrenner重新進場，主要是因為交易標的與其過去的投資布局高度重疊。
Situational Awareness在6月底提交的監管文件顯示，SanDisk與美光當時分別約占基金持倉57億美元及56億美元，是該基金最大的兩項投資。此次近億美元的期權交易，也集中在這兩檔股票上。
此外，這批交易採用大額、短天期看漲期權的方式，也與Aschenbrenner過去的操作風格相近。其基金過去曾以高槓桿押注AI市場動能，槓桿率一度達400%。透過大量買進短期看漲期權，可能促使做市商進行Gamma避險交易，進而推升相關股票價格。
交易時間點也與近期市場觀察相互呼應。《金融時報》9月11日報導，Aschenbrenner已透過彈性期權（Flex Options），重新建立超微半導體(AMD-US) 、英特爾、SK海力士(SKHY-US) 、SanDisk及CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 等標的的部位。
野村證券策略師Charlie McElligott當時觀察到，AI及半導體相關標的在數日內累計出現約3.15億美元的期權權利金交易，涉及約11億美元的Delta曝險。
他也指出，半導體ETF未來3個月的看漲期權偏斜度已升至歷史高位。

改用全額支付期權　但押注AI動能的策略未變

Aschenbrenner的基金今年7月遭遇重大損失。在AI類股回檔期間，Situational Awareness基金淨值暴跌67%，並將大部分持倉出售給Citadel。
《金融時報》當時將這起事件列為避險基金史上最大單筆虧損之一，但該基金當年仍錄得約80%的正報酬。
Aschenbrenner在7月底致投資人的信中表示，未來將「另謀再戰之日」，並承諾日後的公開市場投資將採取「全額支付」方式管理。
與先前透過總收益互換（TRS）取得槓桿的做法不同，市場認為Aschenbrenner這次改用全額支付期權。這類交易的最大損失通常限於已支付的權利金，理論上不會面臨追繳保證金或因槓桿而遭到強制平倉的風險。
這項調整可能與基金在崩盤後面臨的融資限制有關。摩根大通已終止與該基金的借貸關係，美國證券交易委員會也向曾為基金提供融資的銀行索取相關資訊，先前合作的經紀商則遭到美國司法部調查。
據《金融時報》報導，Aschenbrenner後續轉向專注科技產業的經紀商Clear Street，重新建立合作關係。
不過， McElligott指出，近期交易仍呈現股價與波動率同步上升的特徵，與7月市場崩跌前的情況相似。這代表交易仍可能集中押注流動性相對有限、具市場動能的股票，試圖透過期權交易帶動股價進一步上漲。
若市場動能反轉，短天期期權的權利金可能迅速歸零，但投資人無法再透過調整槓桿來緩衝損失。
Situational Awareness第3季的13F持股報告預計於11月中旬提交，屆時市場才能透過監管文件確認這批期權交易的實際買家身分。

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro開賣！分析師挺蘋果：換機周期優於預期 股價有13%上漲空間
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Goes on Sale! Analysts Back Apple: Upgrade Cycle Better Than Expected, Stock Has About 13% Upside
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)最新一波iPhone產品採取全高階機款策略，這項做法雖然具有風險，但Evercore ISI分析師認為，這項策略最終將有利於蘋果營收與股價表現。
Evercore ISI分析師Amit Daryanani周五(18日)將蘋果目標價從365美元提升至380美元，較蘋果周四收盤價每股337美元還有約13%的上漲空間。蘋果周五終場下跌0.7%，收在每股334.64美元。
Evercore在完成對約4000名消費者的年度iPhone購買意願調查後，認為iPhone換機周期可能優於預期，因而做出最新預測。
Daryanani寫道：「需求似乎略優於去年，這可能讓iPhone在強勁的升級周期後，迎來另一波成長。」他給予蘋果「優於大盤」的評等。

iPhone 18 Pro先上市 標準版明春推出

iPhone 18 Pro與iPhone 18 Pro Max在上周的蘋果發表會首次亮相，本周五正式在門市與線上通路開賣。
蘋果今年作風與以往不同，iPhone 18系列只先推出高階Pro機型，而華爾街預期，蘋果將在明年春季推出iPhone 18標準款。以往的蘋果會在同一時間推出新iPhone的四款機型。
高價手機如果能熱賣，將有利於蘋果營收與利潤率，但這項策略也存在風險。iPhone 18 Pro系列售價較前代高出100美元，雖然是為了因應持續的記憶體成本危機才調漲價格，這可能對市場需求造成壓力。

電信商提高優惠 抵銷蘋果漲價壓力

美銀證券(BofA Securities)分析師Wamsi Mohan周四在報告中指出，美國無線電信商已提高購買iPhone的優惠幅度，此舉「大致抵銷了蘋果今年的漲價」。他給予蘋果「買進」評等，目標價370美元。
其他分析師同樣看好iPhone 18 Pro銷售。摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)分析師Erik Woodring周三在報告中指出，iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max的交貨等待時間，也就是消費者下單至收到產品所需的時間，顯示這兩款手機的「潛在需求更健康」。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is launching its latest wave of iPhone products with an all‑premium‑model strategy. While this approach carries risk, Evercore ISI analyst believes it will ultimately benefit Apple’s revenue and stock performance.

Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani raised Apple’s target price on Friday (the 18th) from $365 to $380, implying roughly a 13% upside from Apple’s Thursday close of $337 per share. Apple closed Friday down 0.7% at $334.64 per share.
After completing its annual iPhone purchase‑intent survey of about 4,000 consumers, Evercore sees the iPhone upgrade cycle potentially outpacing expectations, prompting its latest forecast.

Daryanani wrote, “Demand appears slightly stronger than last year, which could give the iPhone another growth wave after a robust upgrade cycle.” He assigned Apple an “out‑perform” rating relative to the broader market.

The iPhone 18 Pro launches first, with the standard model slated for next spring. The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max debuted at Apple’s event last week and went on sale in stores and online on Friday.

Apple’s approach this year differs from the past: the iPhone 18 series is being introduced with only the high‑end Pro models, while Wall Street expects the standard iPhone 18 to arrive in spring next year. Historically, Apple released all four new iPhone models simultaneously.

If the high‑priced phones sell well, they will boost Apple’s revenue and profit margins, but the strategy also carries risk. The iPhone 18 Pro series is priced about $100 higher than its predecessor, a hike driven by ongoing memory‑cost pressures that could weigh on demand.

Bank of America Securities analyst Wamsi Mohan noted on Thursday that U.S. wireless carriers have increased iPhone purchase incentives, a move that “largely offsets Apple’s price hikes this year.” He gave Apple a “Buy” rating with a $370 target price.

Other analysts are similarly optimistic about iPhone 18 Pro sales. Morgan Stanley analyst Erik Woodring said on Wednesday that the delivery wait times for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max—i.e., the time from order to receipt—indicate “healthier underlying demand” for the two models.

items.title: Anthropic引進第三方安全評估！埃森哲消弭AI取代疑慮 盤後飆漲8%
items.title_en: Anthropic Introduces Third-Party Safety Assessment! Accenture Eases AI Replacement Concerns, Shares Jump 8% After Hours
paras: Anthropic宣布將與科技顧問商埃森哲(Accenture)(ACN-US)合作，推動人工智慧(AI)安全評估，帶動其股價周五(18日)盤後大漲，擺脫近期歷經的劇烈跌勢。
雙方將在Anthropic內部進駐一支獨立安全評估團隊，由Accenture旗下專精AI業務的Faculty主導這項合作。兩家公司預估未來五年至少投資10億美元在AI安全評估上。
Accenture股價周五盤後跳漲8%。該股周五稍早正常交易時段下跌4.7%至每股181.29美元，主因Guggenheim分析師調降評等。

AI安全疑慮升溫 Anthropic要求放慢開發速度

雙方合作正值全美AI安全討論升溫之際。今年夏季，數百個OpenAI自主AI代理人攻入OpenAI內部系統以及開發者平台Hugging Face，引起注目。接著上周一名Anthropic研究員辭職，並發文指責整個AI產業推進AI發展的速度不負責任，使相關疑慮進一步演變成危機。
Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)隨後呼籲放慢AI開發速度，並要求AI公司引入第三方評估機制。
目前還不清楚這些評估人員將如何運作，也尚未確定具體人選，Anthropic表示，目前正與研究型非營利組織METR及其他非營利評估機構洽談。
Anthropic在公告中表示：「嵌入式評估是一項新做法，許多運作細節仍在制定中。」
Anthropic指出，與目前的外部評估人員不同，嵌入式評估人員將直接在AI公司內部工作，並擁有與公司員工相近的存取權限。

AI安全業務 可能成為Accenture股價新助力

Anthropic與Accenture的合作並非排他性合作，Anthropic表示，預期Accenture也將以類似方式與其他AI開發商合作。
這項潛在的新業務，代表Accenture的AI題材可能出現重大轉折。該公司今年來股價下跌32%，投資人一直擔心AI工具可能降低企業對顧問服務的需求。
但《巴隆周刊》指出，如果Accenture能在AI安全業務中扮演領導角色，AI可能不再是該公司的阻力，反而可能成為推升股價的助力。
paras_en: Anthropic announced it will partner with technology consulting firm Accenture (ACN-US) to promote AI safety assessments, driving its stock to surge after hours on Friday the 18th, shedding the recent steep decline.

The two parties will embed an independent safety assessment team within Anthropic, led by Accenture’s AI-focused Faculty unit. The companies estimate they will invest at least $1 billion over the next five years in AI safety assessments.
Accenture’s shares jumped 8% after hours on Friday. Earlier in the regular trading session the stock fell 4.7% to $181.29 per share, mainly because a Guggenheim analyst downgraded its rating.

AI safety concerns are rising; Anthropic calls for slower development. The collaboration comes as AI safety discussions heat up across the U.S. This summer, hundreds of autonomous OpenAI agents breached OpenAI’s internal systems and the developer platform Hugging Face, drawing attention. Then last Monday an Anthropic researcher resigned and posted that the entire AI industry is advancing development at an irresponsible pace, turning the concerns into a crisis.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei subsequently urged a slowdown in AI development and called for AI companies to adopt third‑party assessment mechanisms.

It is still unclear how these assessors will operate, and no specific personnel have been identified yet; Anthropic said it is in talks with the research nonprofit METR and other nonprofit assessment organizations.
In the announcement, Anthropic said: “Embedded assessment is a new approach, and many operational details are still being defined.”
Anthropic noted that unlike current external assessors, embedded assessors will work directly inside the AI company and will have access rights comparable to those of company employees.

AI safety business could become a new driver for Accenture’s stock. The partnership with Anthropic is not exclusive; Anthropic expects Accenture will work with other AI developers in a similar manner.

This potential new line of business could represent a major turning point for Accenture’s AI theme. The company’s stock has fallen 32% this year, and investors have been worried that AI tools might reduce demand for consulting services.
But Barron’s noted that if Accenture can play a leading role in AI safety, AI may no longer be a drag on the company but rather a boost to its share price.

items.title: 隱藏版AI半導體黑馬！MACOM受惠AI資料中心擴建 一年來大漲超過100%
items.title_en: Hidden AI Semiconductor Dark Horse! MACOM Benefits from AI Data Center Expansion, Surges Over 100% in a Year
paras: 鮮為人知的半導體公司MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings(MTSI-US)因受惠於資料中心加速擴建，逐漸受到華爾街關注。
MACOM股價周五(18日)上漲4.83%，收盤報每股275.86美元，過去一年累計飆升117%。大盤同步上揚，iShares Semiconductor ETF(SOXX-US)上漲1%，個股中，博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)上漲2.2%，恩智浦(NXP Semiconductors)(NXPI-US)則下跌0.9%。
BMO資本市場周四將MACOM評等從「與大盤一致」(Market Perform)調升至「優於大盤」(Outperform)，儘管MACOM股價目前仍比歷史收盤高點409.68美元低33%。
BMO分析師Harsh Kumar表示，MACOM獲利成長受到AI資料中心強勁需求帶動，令人「感到振奮」。此外，國防市場「仍具韌性」，航太業務可望在2027年成為帶動公司成長的「重要貢獻來源」。
近來華爾街對MACOM的看法大致偏多。根據FactSet調查的16家券商中，有12家給予「買進」評等。在這當中，Jefferies在MACOM今年8月公布最新財報後，將目標價定在450美元，較MACOM目前價位高約70%。
營收年增36%、淨利暴增176%
根據MACOM上月公布的財報，單季營收年增36%至3.422億美元，超越華爾街預期的3.36億美元，淨利暴增176%至1.007億美元。
MACOM周四宣布推出一系列新款微型晶片，專為提升AI資料中心內部的光通訊速度而設計，速度可達前代產品的兩倍。執行長Stephen Daly表示，新款晶片將有助於實現最高效能，同時降低開發工作量。
paras_en: A little‑known semiconductor company, MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings (MTSI‑US), is gradually attracting Wall Street attention as it benefits from the accelerated expansion of data centers.

MACOM’s stock rose 4.83% on Friday (the 18th), closing at $275.86 per share, up 117% over the past year. The broader market also rose, with the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) up 1%; among peers, Broadcom (AVGO‑US) gained 2.2% while NXP Semiconductors (NXPI‑US) fell 0.9%.
BMO Capital Markets upgraded MACOM on Thursday from “Market Perform” to “Outperform,” even though the stock still trades about 33% below its historical high of $409.68.

BMO analyst Harsh Kumar said MACOM’s profit growth is driven by strong demand from AI data centers, which is “exciting.” He added that the defense market “remains resilient,” and the aerospace business could become an “important growth contributor” by 2027.

Wall Street’s view of MACOM has become broadly bullish. Of the 16 brokerages surveyed by FactSet, 12 gave the stock a “Buy” rating. Jefferies, after MACOM’s latest earnings release in August, set a target price of $450, roughly 70% above the current level.
Revenue up 36% YoY, net income jumps 176%

According to MACOM’s earnings released last month, quarterly revenue grew 36% year‑over‑year to $342.2 million, beating Wall Street’s estimate of $336 million, while net income surged 176% to $100.7 million.

MACOM announced on Thursday a new line of micro‑chips designed to double the optical‑communication speed inside AI data centers compared with previous generations. CEO Stephen Daly said the new chips will help achieve peak performance while reducing development workload.

items.title: 摩根士丹利近70億美元私募信貸基金再限贖回！投資人提款需求超額2倍
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Limits Redemption on Nearly $7 Billion Private Credit Fund as Investor Withdrawal Requests Exceed Capacity by 2x
paras: 摩根士丹利(MS-US) 第三季再度限制旗下近70億美元私募信貸基金的贖回，因為投資人申請贖回規模超過基金願意回購金額的兩倍。
根據《彭博》報導， 摩根士丹利旗下的 North Haven Private Income Fund將贖回上限設為5%，而投資者申請贖回11.4%的份額，與前三個月基本持平。
基金表示，截至9月的三個季度累計完成回購約4.79億美元，近三分之二申請來自先前兩輪受限投資者。
儘管大型私募信貸基金最近一季收到的贖回申請大致減少，但投資人持續嘗試從規模達1.8兆美元的私募信貸市場撤回資金，提款壓力仍處於相對高檔。
摩根士丹利也因此與黑石(BX-US) 、貝萊德(BLK-US) 等同業一樣，持續限制投資人可贖回的資金規模。
基金管理公司目前仍在處理約150億美元的待贖回申請。過去一年，市場曾出現創紀錄的資金撤出潮，主因投資人擔憂放款審核標準，以及貸款機構對早期軟體投資的曝險程度。
此外，摩根士丹利旗下另一檔總投資規模不到10億美元的基金，也因收到約占基金股份7%的贖回申請，而限制投資人贖回。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Morgan Stanley (MS-US) again restricted redemptions on its nearly $7 billion private credit fund in Q3, because investor redemption requests were more than twice the amount the fund was willing to buy back.

According to Bloomberg, Morgan Stanley's North Haven Private Income Fund set a redemption cap at 5%, while investors applied to redeem 11.4% of their holdings, roughly in line with the previous three months.

The fund said that through the three quarters ending September it had repurchased about $479 million, with nearly two‑thirds of the requests coming from investors who were already subject to earlier redemption limits.

Although redemption requests to large private‑credit funds have generally eased in the most recent quarter, investors continue to try pulling money out of the $1.8 trillion private‑credit market, keeping withdrawal pressure relatively high.
Morgan Stanley, like peers such as BlackRock (BLK-US) and Blackstone (BX-US), is therefore continuing to limit the amount investors can redeem.

The fund manager is still processing roughly $15 billion of pending redemption requests. Over the past year the market saw a record‑setting wave of outflows, driven by investor concerns over loan underwriting standards and lenders' exposure to early‑stage software investments.

In addition, another Morgan Stanley fund with a total investment size of under $1 billion also imposed redemption limits after receiving redemption requests amounting to about 7% of the fund’s shares.
This article is not available for partner re‑publication.

items.title: 輝達加持的AI新創Nscale申請上市！上半年營收暴增12.5倍仍虧損逾10億美元
items.title_en: Nvidia-Backed AI Startup Nscale Files for IPO! H1 Revenue Surges 12.5‑Fold Yet Losses Exceed $1 Billion
paras: 獲輝達(NVDA-US)投資、專注人工智慧(AI)模型基礎設施的雲端服務商Nscale，周五(18日)已向紐約證券交易所(NYSE)申請上市，股票代號為「NSCL」。
根據Nscale首次公開發行(IPO)說明書，在截至今年6月30日的六個月內期間，營收為1.406億美元，淨虧損達10.2億美元。相比之下，去年同期淨損為3.689億美元，營收僅1040萬美元，代表營收較去年同期暴增1252%。
Nscale並透露，目前為止的剩餘履約義務(RPO)達564億美元。
對手包括亞馬遜、CoreWeave
Nscale的競爭對手包括市場領先的雲端服務商亞馬遜(AMZN-US)，以及CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)等被稱為「新雲」(neocloud)的新一代供應商。
自2022年ChatGPT推出以來，OpenAI、Anthropic等AI實驗室對運算能力的需求似乎永無止境。因此，Anthropic與OpenAI都需要大量現金支付算力費用，兩家公司也都計劃上市。
這兩家AI實驗室都已與Nscale達成交易，由Nscale出租輝達圖形處理器(GPU)，供AI模型訓練與運行使用。
本身也是雲端服務商的微軟(MSFT-US)也已與Nscale簽約。Nscale表示，2026年上半年有一家未具名客戶貢獻超過一半營收。
尋求分散客戶、靠收購擴大AI服務
Nscale近來也試圖分散業務來源，目前已開始提供多款AI模型的推理服務。此外，7月還宣布計劃收購協助建構AI模型的新創軟體公司Anyscale。
Nscale上周宣布，曾任OpenAI、Instacart(CART-US)與Meta(META-US)高層的Fidji Simo加入董事會。其他董事會成員還包括Meta前高層Nick Clegg與桑柏格(Sheryl Sandberg)。
### 手握46.1萬顆GPU合約　但負債逾80億美元
截至8月31日，Nscale擁有2.5萬顆啟用中的GPU，若加入已啟用或已簽約的GPU，總數達46.1萬顆。公司目前擁有五座已啟用、12座已簽約的資料中心據點。
Nscale表示目前已掌握相當於10GW的運算能力，負債則超過80億美元，這個金額還沒把與AI伺服器製造商戴爾(DELL-US)的融資計畫算進來。
Nscale總部位於倫敦，截至8月31日擁有逾1000名全職員工。該公司於2024年結束神秘模式，從加密貨幣挖礦公司Arkon Energy分拆成立，投資人包括Blue Owl、戴爾、輝達、Fidelity與Point72。
Nscale今年3月表示，在其中一輪募資中，投資人對公司的估值達146億美元。
根據Nscale向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)提交的文件，輝達同意為Nscale在德州一項資料中心租賃協議下最高8.6億美元的義務提供擔保。
paras_en: Nscale, a cloud‑service provider focused on AI model infrastructure and backed by Nvidia (NVDA‑US), filed on Friday (the 18th) for a listing on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the ticker "NSCL".

According to Nscale’s prospectus, revenue for the six‑month period ending June 30 this year was $140.6 million, while net loss reached $1.02 billion. By contrast, the same period last year saw a net loss of $368.9 million and revenue of only $10.4 million, meaning revenue jumped 1,252% year‑over‑year.
Nscale disclosed that its remaining performance obligations (RPO) to date total $56.4 billion.
Competitors include Amazon and CoreWeave.
Nscale’s rivals comprise market‑leading cloud provider Amazon (AMZN‑US) as well as next‑generation “neocloud” suppliers such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Nebius (NBIS‑US).

Since the launch of ChatGPT in 2022, AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic have shown seemingly endless demand for compute power. Consequently, both Anthropic and OpenAI need massive cash to pay for compute and are planning IPOs themselves.
Both AI labs have struck deals with Nscale, which rents Nvidia graphics processing units (GPUs) to them for training and running AI models.
Microsoft (MSFT‑US), also a cloud provider, has signed a contract with Nscale. Nscale said an unnamed customer contributed more than half of its revenue in the first half of 2026.
Seeking to diversify its customer base and grow AI services through acquisitions

Nscale has recently been trying to diversify its revenue sources; it has begun offering inference services for a variety of AI models and announced in July a plan to acquire the AI‑model‑building startup Anyscale.

Last week Nscale announced that Fidji Simo, a former senior executive at OpenAI, Instacart (CART‑US) and Meta (META‑US), has joined its board. Other board members include former Meta executive Nick Clegg and Sheryl Sandberg.
### Holding contracts for 461,000 GPUs but debt exceeds $8 billion

As of August 31, Nscale operated 25,000 active GPUs; counting GPUs already activated or under contract brings the total to 461,000. The company currently runs five active data‑center sites and has contracts for twelve additional sites.
Nscale says it now controls roughly 10 GW of compute capacity, while its debt tops $8 billion, not including financing arrangements with AI‑server maker Dell (DELL‑US).

Nscale is headquartered in London and had more than 1,000 full‑time employees as of August 31. The company emerged from “stealth mode” in 2024, spinning out of cryptocurrency miner Arkon Energy, with investors such as Blue Owl, Dell, Nvidia, Fidelity and Point72.
In March this year Nscale disclosed that a financing round valued the company at $14.6 billion.
SEC filings show that Nvidia has agreed to provide a guarantee of up to $860 million for Nscale’s Texas data‑center lease obligations.

items.title: Anthropic擬在IPO前推新AI模型！迎戰OpenAI Astra、企業市場與獲利迎雙重考驗
items.title_en: Anthropic Plans to Launch New AI Model Ahead of IPO, Facing Dual Test of OpenAI Astra, Enterprise Market and Profitability
paras: 三名知情人士表示，Anthropic正評估推出新一代人工智慧（AI）模型，以因應OpenAI近期發布GPT-6 Astra後在企業市場取得的進展。相關討論正值Anthropic預計籌備首次公開募股（IPO）之際，且公司執行長此前才呼籲整個產業放慢AI開發步調。
根據《路透》報導，知情人士表示，Anthropic考慮推出新模型的時機，正值公司面臨來自直接競爭對手的競爭壓力。此舉也發生在Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei呼籲全球AI社群放慢新功能發布速度、以因應安全疑慮之後。
Amodei本月在一篇長達3,800字的文章中表示，業界「必須放慢AI模型能力提升的速度」。
他警告，大量AI代理可能接管網路運作，發展速度甚至超越人類的控制能力。這項主張獲得OpenAI執行長Sam Altman及SpaceX執行長馬斯克支持。
不過，OpenAI本月推出的GPT-6 Astra已獲得企業客戶與開發者正面回應，部分投資人開始重新評估Anthropic在企業AI工具市場的領先地位。
知情人士表示，Anthropic目前正評估下一款模型的安全性，並據此研議是否推出產品。
根據知情人士，公司內部也在討論，如何在投入新模型發布的同時強化獲利能力。隨著利率走高，投資人更加重視企業何時能實現預期獲利。
除了利率走高之外，開源AI供應商的激烈競爭，尤其是來自中國業者的競爭，也加劇了這項壓力。
Anthropic未回應路透社的置評請求。

GPT-6 Astra搶進企業市場　OpenAI市占表現受到關注

OpenAI於9月3日發布GPT-6 Astra，主打電腦操作、軟體工程、資安及專業工作等領域的能力提升。該模型推出後，在企業用戶與開發者間獲得良好反應，也促使有意參與Anthropic IPO的投資人重新檢視OpenAI是否可能搶占Anthropic的市場份額。
Anthropic過去數月一直被視為企業AI工具市場的領先業者，但最新數據顯示，OpenAI在部分指標上已取得進展。
根據企業支出管理平台Ramp的最新數據，GPT-6 Astra約占該平台追蹤的企業AI支出13%，Anthropic旗下Claude Fable則約占8%。
此外，OpenRouter上週的使用數據也顯示，用戶在OpenAI模型的支出首次超越Anthropic模型。
OpenRouter是一個廣泛使用的AI模型路由平台，可將開發者流量分配至不同模型。該平台表示，這是OpenAI超過兩年半以來，首次在這項指標上領先Anthropic。

Anthropic營收規模仍領先　投資人關注AI商業模式

儘管OpenAI近期取得進展，但部分Anthropic現有投資人，以及計畫參與兩家公司IPO的投資人認為，GPT-6 Astra目前尚不足以對Anthropic構成重大威脅。
他們指出，Anthropic在企業AI工具市場仍擁有相當的領先幅度，而大型企業更換既有供應商通常需要一段時間。
根據《路透》先前報導，Anthropic截至7月底的年化營收運行率已突破650億美元，較2025年底約90億美元大幅成長。公司預估2028年營收可達1,900億至2,000億美元。
相比之下，OpenAI今年7月的年化營收運行率突破400億美元。
不過，投資人也預期，隨著Anthropic、OpenAI、Alphabet旗下Google及其他主要AI開發商陸續推出新一代模型，產業領先地位可能持續變動，任何競爭優勢都可能難以長期維持。
投資人認為，對Anthropic及其他主要AI業者而言，開源與開放權重模型的崛起，可能構成比OpenAI競爭更具長期性的挑戰。
這類模型有機會降低Token使用成本，也讓企業能自行建置更多AI基礎設施，減少對Anthropic及OpenAI等商業模型供應商的依賴。
隨著企業在模型開發與運行方面擁有更多選擇，AI產業的商業模式可能面臨壓力，市場競爭也將不再侷限於Anthropic與OpenAI之間。
知情人士透露，Meta一直是Anthropic的重要客戶之一，但隨著Meta持續強化內部AI能力，公司正考慮降低對Anthropic模型的使用量。

OpenAI暫緩上市　Anthropic IPO時程仍待確認

在上市規畫方面， Altman近日也證實，OpenAI不會在2026年上市，並表示考慮到AI安全問題，目前並非適合推動IPO的時機。
至於Anthropic，兩名知情人士透露，公司可能將IPO延後至美國11月期中選舉之後，且預期選舉不會對上市計畫造成重大影響。
Anthropic的IPO時程先前已較原定計畫延後。根據《路透》此前報導，公司最早可能於10月中旬開始進行上市行銷作業。
paras_en: Three insiders say Anthropic is evaluating the launch of a next‑generation artificial intelligence (AI) model to counter OpenAI’s recent rollout of GPT‑6 Astra and its gains in the enterprise market. The discussion comes as Anthropic prepares for a planned initial public offering (IPO), and the company’s CEO has recently urged the industry to slow down AI development pace.

According to Reuters, insiders say Anthropic is timing the consideration of a new model amid competitive pressure from direct rivals. The move also follows CEO Dario Amodei’s call for the global AI community to slow the release of new features due to safety concerns.
Amodei wrote a 3,800‑word essay this month stating the industry "must slow the pace of AI model capability improvements."
He warned that a flood of AI agents could take over internet operations, developing faster than human control can manage. The claim has been backed by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk.

Nevertheless, OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra, launched this month, has received positive feedback from corporate customers and developers, prompting some investors to reassess Anthropic’s lead in the enterprise AI tools market.
Insiders say Anthropic is currently evaluating the safety of its next model and, based on that assessment, deciding whether to bring a product to market.

Sources indicate the company is also debating how to boost profitability while investing in a new model launch. With rising interest rates, investors are paying closer attention to when firms can deliver expected profits.
In addition to higher rates, fierce competition from open‑source AI providers, especially Chinese firms, is adding pressure.
Anthropic did not respond to Reuters’ request for comment.

GPT‑6 Astra pushes into the enterprise market, drawing attention to OpenAI’s market share performance. OpenAI released GPT‑6 Astra on September 3, highlighting improvements in computer operation, software engineering, cybersecurity and professional work. The model has been well received by enterprise users and developers, prompting investors eyeing Anthropic’s IPO to re‑evaluate whether OpenAI could capture Anthropic’s market share.
Anthropic has been viewed for months as the leading player in the enterprise AI tools market, but the latest data show OpenAI has made progress on several metrics.

According to the latest data from enterprise spend‑management platform Ramp, GPT‑6 Astra accounts for about 13% of the AI spend tracked on the platform, while Anthropic’s Claude Fable accounts for roughly 8%.
Furthermore, usage data from OpenRouter last week showed that spending on OpenAI models overtook Anthropic models for the first time.

OpenRouter is a widely used AI model routing platform that distributes developer traffic across different models. The platform said this is the first time in over two and a half years that OpenAI has led Anthropic on this metric.

Anthropic’s revenue scale still leads, drawing investor focus on AI business models. Despite OpenAI’s recent gains, some existing Anthropic investors and those planning to back both companies’ IPOs believe GPT‑6 Astra is not yet a serious threat to Anthropic.
They note that Anthropic still enjoys a substantial lead in the enterprise AI tools market, and large enterprises typically take time to switch existing suppliers.

Reuters previously reported that Anthropic’s annualized revenue run‑rate had surpassed $65 billion as of the end of July, up sharply from about $9 billion at the end of 2025. The company projects 2028 revenue of $190 billion to $200 billion.
By comparison, OpenAI’s annualized revenue run‑rate broke $40 billion in July this year.

However, investors also expect that as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google (under Alphabet) and other major AI developers roll out new‑generation models, leadership positions may continue to shift, and any competitive edge could be short‑lived.
Investors believe that for Anthropic and other leading AI firms, the rise of open‑source and open‑weight models could pose a longer‑term challenge than competition from OpenAI alone.
Such models could lower token‑usage costs and enable enterprises to build more of their own AI infrastructure, reducing reliance on commercial model providers like Anthropic and OpenAI.
As enterprises gain more choices in model development and operation, the AI industry’s business model may come under pressure, and competition will no longer be limited to Anthropic versus OpenAI.

Sources reveal that Meta has been one of Anthropic’s major customers, but as Meta continues to strengthen its internal AI capabilities, the company is considering cutting back its use of Anthropic models.

OpenAI has paused its IPO plans; Anthropic’s IPO timing remains uncertain. Altman recently confirmed that OpenAI will not go public in 2026, citing AI safety concerns as making an IPO unsuitable at this time.
Regarding Anthropic, two insiders say the company may push its IPO until after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November, and they expect the election will not materially affect the listing plan.
Anthropic’s IPO timeline has already been pushed back from the original schedule. Reuters previously reported that the earliest the company might begin its IPO marketing is mid‑October.
